name: Velocity Edit
summary: A short vertical montage with speed ramps: the clip slows to slow motion, then jumps to fast play on the beat, with glow, zoom shake and a colour grade. Editors make it with the velocity tool of CapCut.

philosophy.core_thesis: Let time bend to the music: slow on the strong beat, fast on the rest.
design_principles: Ramp the speed between 20% and 400%; slow to 20% to 30% on the accent beat and jump to 300% on the off-beat.
Cut every 0.3 s to 1.2 s on the beat of a 120 BPM to 140 BPM track.
Add a zoom of 100% to 115% in 6 frames at each cut.
Add a glow with a 20 px blur at 30% opacity on highlights.
Use a high-contrast grade: crush blacks to 5% and lift highlights to 95%.
Overlay a 2 px shake of 4 frames on each strong beat.
Put one short word in 56 px type on the final hit, no more.
anti_patterns: Hard black bars at the sides

layout.grid_mechanics: A single full-bleed frame; no UI grid; type appears only at the final hit, centred.
layout.whitespace_ratio: Clean frame: text and UI take under 5%.
layout.alignment_rules: The subject is centred; the final word is centred at 50% of the height.
layout.container_geometry: Hard rectangle with 0 radius; a thin 1 px white flash frame at each cut.

font_pairings.note: Anton is an open condensed display face for the final hit; Oswald is the body.
A condensed caps face for kinetic words.

hierarchy_rules: Use only one word as the display text.
Set it at 56 px in caps.
Use a white fill with a 20 px glow.

color.palette_structure: Dark frames with a hot orange and cold blue grade; the clip carries the colour.
color.contrast_rules: Highlight on void gives 18:1; glow does not carry text.
color.light_and_shadow: Hard rim light and lens glow; a cold shadow and a warm highlight.

materiality.surface_simulation: A glossy screen with light bloom and a slight film grain.
materiality.border_rules: A 1 px white flash frame on cuts.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: A 20 px bloom on highlights; a 4 px radial blur at the edge on fast frames.

ornamentation_details.iconography: None; the edit has no icon set.
ornamentation_details.illustration: The source clip and light leaks: orange flares at 30% opacity.

motion.transition_physics: Speed ramps of 6 to 12 frames between 20% and 400%; a zoom of 115% in 6 frames at each cut; a 4-frame shake on each strong beat.
motion.hover_and_active: A tap pauses the clip; no hover state.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels a jolt of energy and replays the clip.

avoid_when: The audience needs calm or clear information.
The source footage is dull or low-resolution.
The viewer may have motion sickness.

modifiers.how: Remove the ramps and talk to the lens in a soft room.
Hold one take of 5 s and add a title line.
Replace the ramps with a swipe through 6 stills.

pack.why: A bold family with heavy shapes that fit a high-contrast edit.

ground.why: The ground is a ray burst that echoes the light flares of the edit.

tailwind.classes: rounded-none bg-[#FF6A1F] px-6 py-3 text-sm font-bold uppercase text-[#08090C]
